subject: CHANGES REQUESTED: S15b generation (client can delete rows to undo the quota pause and daily cap; patient names reach the Space; WebKit e2e fails)
body:
Reviewer: review15b. Reviewed origin/claude/naadi-shared @ 017555f (S15b commits c013b10, 9197133, d3af48c, c99420b, plus three more S15b commits that the done message leaves out: 827e8d9 gen-space + deploy-gen, 0b89cbc web + e2e, d5c70e1 OpenAPI names).
These lead decisions are respected and NOT counted as defects: generation stays not_configured without HF_GEN_TOKEN; video is OFF (cap 0, NAADI_GEN_VIDEO off); publishing is image-to-figure only; the tutor tools and canvas registration wait for S14's registry.

## Defects

1. MAJOR: the quota pause and the per-user daily cap can be undone by the client. Server-side enforcement is broken.
   apps/api/naadi_api/generation/service.py:131-150 (`_paused_until`, `_used`) and health.py:21-25. Both are computed from `generated_media` rows. Migration 0022 (apps/api/migrations/versions/0022_generation.py:60) keeps DELETE for `authenticated`, and the `generated_media_delete_own` policy still applies. `DELETE /api/generated/{id}` (routes.py:126) does the same thing.
   - The pause is "the newest unexpired paused row". The student who owns that row can delete it, which ends the pause for every user.
   - The cap counts existing queued/generating/ready rows. Delete each item and the cap never fills, so one user can drain the owner's shared ZeroGPU quota.
   Repro on local PG at head (as the user, in one transaction):
     insert a 'paused' row (paused_until = now()+5h) and a 'ready' row for user U
     set role authenticated; set request.jwt.claims sub=U; delete from public.generated_media;  (what supabase-js .delete() sends)
     Before: pause=2026-11-17 11:14 UTC, used=1. After: pause=none, used=0.
   Fix direction: keep usage and the pause in something the client can't delete. For example, a soft delete (a `deleted_at` column, revoke DELETE, the API hides the row and removes the file), or a separate API-only usage/pause table written in the same migration. Count every run that reached the Space (failed runs included, e.g. generation_timeout, which still spent GPU) and add a db test for both bypasses.

2. MAJOR (privacy): person names reach the Space and are stored as the prompt.
   apps/api/naadi_api/generation/rules.py:233-250. `scrub_generic` only removes emails, phones and ids. The real-person rule only fires after a cue ("photo of", an honorific), and "Smith" is on the eponym allow-list (rules.py:263).
   These pass with ok=True, and the stored and sent prompt is unchanged:
     "my patient Priya Sharma with a rash, cartoon"
     "an illustration of a woman named Anita Desai with jaundice"
     "portrait of John Smith"
     "a cartoon of a patient named Rahul Verma, MRN [id]"
   The spec requires prompts scrubbed of PII and refusal of real people and patients. At minimum, refuse "patient|named|called <Capitalised Name>" and "my patient …". Treat an eponym as anatomical only when an anatomy word follows it ("Smith fracture"), not when the name stands alone after a portrait/photo cue. Add these cases to tests/generation/test_rules.py.

3. MEDIUM: generation.spec.ts fails in WebKit on the current tip (smoke set: 6 of 16 fail, both runs, --retries=0, chromium-laptop-1440 passes).
   a) apps/web/e2e/generation.spec.ts:170 and :222. The spec's own `errors` collector fails on "[Report Only] This requires a TrustedScriptURL value … require-trusted-types-for 'script'". Trusted Types have shipped report-only since 914a5ed. Filter those lines the way csp.spec / ink spec do (3ca7f89).
   b) apps/web/e2e/generation.spec.ts:184-213 (paused test). In WebKit the `page.route("**/api/generated?*")` stub is never applied: the page shows "Nothing generated yet" (test-failed-1.png) and "Generation is paused" is never found. The likely cause is the service worker answering the request. planner.spec.ts:73 creates its contexts with `serviceWorkers: "block"` for this reason. Give the generation spec's contexts the same isolation.
   Repro: pnpm --filter @naadi/web exec playwright test e2e/generation.spec.ts --retries=0 --workers=2 --project webkit-ipad-portrait --project webkit-ipad-landscape --project webkit-phone-390 --project chromium-laptop-1440

4. MINOR: in deploy/gen-space/app.py:59 and :84, validation runs inside the `@spaces.GPU` functions, and so does the `video_disabled` refusal (app.py:85). Invalid input or a disabled video request therefore still asks ZeroGPU for a slot (20-120 s requested) before it is refused. Validate in a thin non-GPU wrapper that is exposed via gr.api, then call the GPU function.

5. MINOR: in apps/api/naadi_api/generation/client.py:200, `client.submit(...)` sits outside the try. If submit raises (e.g. the Space is asleep or private and the token is wrong), the result is an unhandled exception rather than `generation_unavailable`, and the reserved row stays 'queued' until the 10-minute stale sweep (the user gets generation_busy until then).

## Notes for S14 (not defects)
- `GenerationService.run` doesn't check the `generation` app_config flag itself (service.py:186). That relies on `register_tool(..., requires_flag="generation")`. Keep that requirement in S14's wiring.
- The Library failed card has no retry (retry needs the tool); the chat block passes onRetry. That's fine as long as S14 wires it.

## Checked and OK
- Nothing paid can be triggered: there are no Inference Providers/InferenceClient calls; only gradio_client (pinned 2.7.2) to the private Space. deploy-gen.yml never creates the Space or changes hardware and exits cleanly if the Space is absent. The live smoke runs on workflow_dispatch only. check_env reads only Space metadata.
- Not configured: the flag is forced off without HF_GEN_TOKEN (AppConfigService unavailable), /api/health generation=not_configured (status ok), /generated redirects home, and there are no nav links or dead buttons. The e2e prod-server test passes.
- Labels: the chip uses a word plus an icon in violet, alt text starts with the label, and the approved caption ends with the label. media_assets.source_id = naadi-ai-generated; the sources row has allow_ai_ingest=false (in both the migration and config/sources.yaml).
- Admin-only approval: AdminUser gate; db tests confirm that non-admins get 403 and the client can't set approved_for_publish. It creates a chapter_section_revisions row (origin admin) and section_media. Videos are refused.
- Migration 0022: grants and RLS are in the same migration (authenticated has SELECT and DELETE only, anon nothing, RLS on). There is a single alembic head (0026 at the time of review), and rls coverage and live_check are updated.
- ui_copy: every string has a generation.* key, REQUIRED_UI_COPY_KEYS is updated, and the noHardcodedCopy root is added.
- Space code: requirements are pinned exactly (torch is platform-provided, with a comment saying so), and README frontmatter has sdk gradio 6.32.0 and zero-a10g. No secrets appear in the diff (scanned). HF_GEN_TOKEN is listed in SECRETS.md, .env.example (empty) and check_env.

## Suites (local, own containers *-rev15b; the hosted DB was never touched)
- Unit: 1318 passed. Lint, typecheck and gen:contracts/gen:requirements: clean, no drift. Vitest: 748 passed (web 513).
- db (local supabase/postgres + storage + auth): tests/generation 24/24 pass. Unrelated failures (also red in CI run 44024505753 db job): test_migrations round trip (0024 agent_health / user-uploads bucket), test_seed live_check counts, qbank answer-column audit (authoring), embeddings (models not cached locally).
- e2e smoke set: 10/16 pass, twice. The 6 failures are defect 3.
- CI: run 44024505753 (fc4e65b, every S15b commit except c99420b). lint/typecheck/unit/drift/build passed; the db job failed only on the non-S15b tests above, with the generation db tests passing; the e2e matrix was still in progress at review time. Later runs (167-176) are still queued, so I couldn't judge the full matrix.
- Screenshots: test-results/screens/15b/* (library, delete-confirm, admin-list, admin-dialog at iPad portrait/landscape, phone 390, laptop 1440). The layout is clean: the label is visible and nothing is clipped. There is no WebKit paused-state screenshot because of defect 3b.
